title: Albumin

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Albumin is a protein made by the liver. It helps keep fluid from leaking out of blood vessels and carries hormones, vitamins and enzymes through the body.
context: Albumin is often lower during pregnancy, after not eating for a day or two, and with some medicines such as birth control pills. Steroids, insulin and some hormones can raise it.
aboveRange: Certain medicines, such as steroids, insulin or hormones
belowRange: Not getting enough protein in the diet, or problems absorbing it
Infection, large burns or thyroid conditions
Pregnancy, not eating for 24 to 48 hours, or certain medicines
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
